verdict.rationale: Pulumi ESC documents acting as an OIDC provider that issues short-lived, signed tokens, which AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud exchange for temporary credentials. That is Pulumi's own credential-issuance capability and could supply time-bounded credentials to an agent. However, the evidence never shows scoping these credentials to least privilege, and never ties them to agent personas. missing for 10: documented scoped or least-privilege Pulumi Cloud API tokens, agent-specific credential issuance, permission-scoping controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Pulumi ESC can act as an OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, issuing short-lived, signed tokens that these clouds exchange for temporary credentials.
